subject.title: Feature Request: Support concurrent multi-account backups via wacli profiles

question: Should Wacrawl add a core profile/source-adapter architecture for concurrent named `wacli` accounts, and should historical Git snapshots be merged into a live archive or exposed through a separate federated-search workflow?
rationale: The current implementation intentionally preserves separate account archives without profiles, and the request combines multiple persistence, source-security, CLI, backup, and historical-search contracts whose boundary cannot be selected mechanically.

options.title: Phase core profiles first
options.body: Define isolated profile state and a read-only `wacli` source contract for concurrent account backups, then track historical snapshot federation as a separate design item.

options.title: Keep Desktop-only scope
options.body: Retain the current single-source archive model and close the broader profile direction unless a maintainer sponsors a supported multi-account source architecture.

options.title: Adopt federated historical search
options.body: Prioritize a read-only cross-snapshot query surface before adding any new live-source or profile model.

recommendation.title: Phase core profiles first
recommendation.body: Define isolated profile state and a read-only `wacli` source contract for concurrent account backups, then track historical snapshot federation as a separate design item.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main archive, account-binding, encrypted-backup, and historical-restore work all trace to this contributor’s merged feature history.
